# Catch 22 Fishing Charters

> Private fishing charters out of Two Georges Marina in Shalimar, FL — running the world-famous waters of Destin. Two boats (Sea Fox 248 Commander and a federally-permitted Grady-White), trips from 3 to 16 hours, up to 6 guests per charter.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Catch 22, the fleet, and featured fishing trips in Destin, FL.
- [About](/about): Meet the captains and crew, learn about the boats and the marina.
- [Booking](/booking): Full trip catalog with durations, prices, and FAQs for every private charter.
- [Kids Trips](/kids-trips): 3-hour catch-and-release trip built for kids and first-time anglers.
- [Shared Charter](/group-charter): Join other anglers on a shared trip for solo, couples, and small families.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from recent Catch 22 charters in Destin, FL.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email, and marina address for booking and questions.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): How we collect, use, and protect your information.
